name: store_buffer
title: The store-buffer test
summary: Two workers each store a one into their own word and then load the other's, many times over. The page counts how often both loaded a zero, which no interleaving of the four operations allows, under each ordering.

controls.name: ordering
controls.label: Ordering
controls.hint: volatile: plain stores and loads. relaxed: atomics with no ordering. release-acquire: a release store, an acquire load. seq_cst: sequentially consistent atomics. fence: plain accesses with a full fence between them.

results.name: both_zero
results.label: Both loaded zero
results.what: trials where neither worker saw the other's store: the outcome no interleaving allows

results.name: other
results.label: Other outcomes
results.what: trials where at least one worker saw the other's store

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: all trials, from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model with a store buffer per thread: a store waits in the buffer until it drains, and a fence drains it
